name: A svarajati in Bilahari
about: "One of the most popular [airs] in Southern India", Day writes, "usually known only by the name of the raga in which it is composed, as the words vary in different parts of the country... believed to be very old." The pallavi, the anupallavi, and the pallavi again; raga Bilahari, tala Adi, with C as sa. Read from a small print, so some notes are uncertain.
